params.body:
Closes #591

The switch "Eigenschappen weergeven" in the order form (`stocklist/_tabs/bestelbonModal.blade.php`) was rendered with `:checked="true"`, whatever the order carried. A dealer who had turned the options off and later edited the order saw the switch on, and saving without looking put the options back on the printed order.

## Changes
- The switch is on for a new order (R S4-4.7) and, otherwise, shows the stored `with_options`. The same expression covers a form that comes back half filled in after creating a relation, and the order made from an offer (no `with_options` yet, so on).
- Rule R S4-4.7 says so; finding `eigenschappen-weergeven-staat-standaard-aan-en-kan` marked solved.

## Tests
- `OrderKeepsItsOptionsSwitchTest`: a new order starts on; an edited order shows off and on as saved. The second test fails on the old view.
- Full suite locally: 3031 tests OK (2 skipped, 1 incomplete). PHPStan: no errors.
params.title: An edited order shows its "Eigenschappen weergeven" as it was saved
